plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Collection of document processing suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF capabilities

plugins.name: example-skills
plugins.description: Collection of example skills demonstrating various capabilities including skill creation, MCP building, visual design, algorithmic art, internal communications, web testing, artifact building, Slack GIFs, and theme styling

plugins.name: claude-api
plugins.description: Claude API and SDK documentation skill for building LLM-powered applications

plugins.name: academy-guide
plugins.description: Recommends relevant Claude Academy courses, tutorials, and use cases when users ask how to use Claude

plugins.name: discernment-nudge
plugins.description: Appends two or three short follow-up questions after a substantive answer to help users check key facts, probe the reasoning, and notice missing context

plugins.name: strict
plugins.description: Strict mode for analysis and content creation: evidence-graded claims, no praise or filler, explicit facts-versus-assumptions separation, and a tiered source list on every created piece

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Token-economy mode: asks whether code or text needs writing at all, reuses existing code, and produces the smallest correct output, with audit, review and debt subcommands
